excerpt: Your rivers already give three quarters of your power, and you renew more fresh water per person than most of the world.
paras: Your rivers already give three quarters of your power, and you renew more fresh water per person than most of the world. About one in nine of you drinks safely managed water. Let the rivers that light the grid also fill every tap.

Your partners are investing in your water and your farms. In September 2025 the World Bank approved $40 million for water security and safe sanitation, and in June 2026 $40 million more for farming. The same month the International Monetary Fund approved a Resilience and Sustainability Facility of $211.5 million, beside the programme it approved in 2024.

The work ahead is plain, and it is worth saying plainly. Only two in every hundred of you cook with clean fuel, and about two in five have electricity. Only eleven in every hundred of you have safely managed drinking water. Eighty-eight in every hundred of you cannot always count on enough good food. Clean energy sets your Coverage today, at 2 out of 100, with water and food close behind. Each of them is within your reach.

Now imagine that same resolve turned toward every home in the country. Picture Perfect Sierra Leone: a morning when every family cooks with clean fuel and sits down to a full table; when every tap runs clean and every home has a safe toilet; when every child walks to a school where a teacher is waiting, and reads with ease by the age of ten; when every mother lives within reach of a clinic with the lights on, and every young person finds work that pays. And no Sierra Leonean falls below a decent life, because the nation has decided that none will.
quote: The rivers already light your grid. Let them fill every tap as well.
